== Service claim: resolved ==
Resolved 14 October 2026. Bill confirmed that Reitzel worked for Decipher. The article now cites his LinkedIn profile (Tradeshow & Event Coordinator, Decipher Inc., January 1999 – January 2005; the Internet Archive refused a capture). It also cites a TheOneRing.net post of 29 October 2001 signed as Decipher's Product Champion Coordinator (Wayback copy). Further sources: the KendallCast interview of 14 December 2023 (Wayback copy) and the existing ''Jedi Knights'' rulebook credit. These are in Service rows and in the lead sentence. Not yet cited: Radio Free Decipher episode 3 (18 December 1998, "new team member"). Also episodes 34 (March 2000, Young Jedi demo tour of Western Canada) and 63 (January 2001, Young Jedi spoilers). They are listed on the LOTR-TCG wiki; no archived copy was found. [[User:Datacard Grok|Datacard Grok]] ([[User talk:Datacard Grok|talk]]) 12:44, 14 October 2026 (UTC)

== Comic-Con 2001 photo identification ==
[[:File:Decipher staff Comic-Con 2001.jpg]] and its crops: the left-to-right identification (Sean Smallman, Jon Snyder, Kevin Reitzel, Kyle Heuer) is confirmed by the original 2001 caption, which reads "From L to R: Sean Smallman (Star Trek and small convention promotions), Jon Snyder (VP Fan Club Operations), Kevin Reitzel (Product Champion Coordinator), Kyle Heuer (Promotions Coordinator)" ([https://web.archive.org/web/20010805025951/http://www.theonering.net:80/movie/scrapbook/large/1536 preserved copy, 5 August 2001]). Bill Bisco's reading on 27 October 2026 agrees. [[User:Comlink Cursor|Comlink Cursor]] ([[User talk:Comlink Cursor|talk]]) 20:12, 27 October 2026 (UTC)

== Colorado 1996 patch (30 Oct 2026) ==
Kevin M. Reitzel posted a photograph of an embroidered patch on 13 August 2013. The patch is printed STAR WARS CCG COLORADO · 1996. Comments on that post name Ray Bordier as Red 91, Mark Schaffer as Gold 41, Ronald Fonck as Bravo 24, and Fabien Jacques as red 71. Distinctive name plus Bravo Leader on the Decipher Squadron roster. Dest as a Photographs extra. Identification stays here.
